description: The base contract. Facts in, two sentences out, {text, caveat} JSON. The forbidden patterns are the numbers a model reaches for when it starts reasoning past its evidence: a race projection, a VO2max, a percentage nobody computed. The runtime guard rejects these mechanically (narration-guard.validateNarration); this cassette catches the prompt DRIFTING toward them, which is the earlier signal.
